# Three Strategies for Reducing Carbon Emissions in Cities

## 1. 🚌 Sustainable Transportation
- Expand public transit (buses, subways, light rail)
- Build cycling infrastructure and pedestrian zones
- Incentivize electric vehicles and phase out combustion engines
- Implement congestion pricing to reduce car traffic

## 2. 🏢 Green Buildings & Energy Efficiency
- Retrofit existing buildings with better insulation and efficient heating/cooling
- Require new construction to meet high energy standards
- Transition to renewable energy sources (solar panels on rooftops)
- Implement smart energy management systems

## 3. 🌳 Urban Planning & Green Infrastructure
- Increase urban green spaces (parks, urban forests) to absorb CO₂
- Develop compact, mixed-use neighborhoods to reduce travel distances
- Implement district heating/cooling systems
- Promote local food production to reduce supply chain emissions

---

**Key takeaway:** The most effective approaches tend to **combine** these strategies, since transportation, buildings, and land use are deeply interconnected systems.
